issue_context.title: Searching in social browser doesn't work
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
Searching in social browser doesn't work. When typing something into the search box, the player list "refreshes", but it doesn't change according to the search input.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
The initial player list looks like this
![osu_2020-01-14_19-23-33](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33959010/72340816-cd7a5f00-3703-11ea-999c-b9b0f9cb44f7.png)
Typing someone's name in the search box, the player list refreshes but doesn't change (and not showing the searched player)
![osu_2020-01-14_19-25-58](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33959010/72340869-eaaf2d80-3703-11ea-960b-005326a9bfda.png)

**osu!lazer version:**
2020.112.0

**Logs:** 
[logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4058858/logs.zip)

review_comments: What happened to this thing? It doesn't seem to display anymore.
probably the haphazard fillflow logic i removed. will need to be added back locally.
